newsitem.title: USA: ACC enters German telecom resale pact.
newsitem.headline: ACC enters German telecom resale pact.

text.p: ACC Corp said on Tuesday its U.K. subsidiary signed a resale agreement with Deutsche Telekom AG -- the first time the German telecommunications giant has entered into this type of arrangement.
The agreement will effectively allow ACC to target small- and medium-sized German businesses and offer telephone services at prices up to 20 percent lower than Deutsche Telekom, ACC said.
ACC said the deal gives it a six-month lead over potential competitors in the German telecommunications market before it becomes more fully deregulated in January 1998.
ACC will offer both local and long distance telephone service, it said.
